wizard.step1.title: SMART vs MANUAL
wizard.step1.body: SMART auto-detects your content type (text, code, markdown). MANUAL lets you pick the type with tabs. Start with Smart!
wizard.step2.title: ADD YOUR CONTENT
wizard.step2.body: Type or paste text, drag & drop files, or browse for images. Smart mode figures out the rest.
wizard.step3.title: FREE TO USE
wizard.step3.body: Completely free! Drops last 7 days by default. Sign in with email for permanent storage.
wizard.step4.title: SERVER UPLOAD
wizard.step4.body: Click to upload to the server. You get a shareable link anyone can open.
wizard.step5.title: P2P MODE (PRIVATE)
wizard.step5.body: Send directly browser-to-browser. Nothing stored on the server — fully private end-to-end transfer. Both tabs must stay open.
